description: Source code file for the 'wal' package in etcd, providing implementation details and documentation for write ahead log functionality used by etcd.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new write ahead log in the specified directory with given metadata.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves raft state and entries to the WAL.

methods.name: SaveSnapshot
methods.description: Records a snapshot to the WAL.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens an existing WAL at a specified directory with an optional snapshot.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all items from the WAL, returning metadata, state, entries, and error.
